facts.text: Under the North Carolina Fixed Tuition Guarantee Program, Appalachian State covers a maximum of eight consecutive fall and spring semesters at a fixed tuition rate for qualifying in-state undergraduates.

sources.title: North Carolina Fixed Tuition Guarantee Program | Student Accounts
sources.quote: Appalachian State's Fixed Tuition benefit covers a maximum of 8 consecutive fall and spring semesters.

sources.title: North Carolina Fixed Tuition Guarantee Program | Student Accounts
sources.quote: To qualify for the Fixed Tuition benefit, students must meet all of the following requirements: Undergraduate status (graduate students are not eligible) First-time, degree-seeking status (students pursuing a second bachelor's or classified as non-degree are not eligible) In-state residency
